about: Example of a banded set. Each basket lists statements per band; a student sees the statements for their band (set by the form teacher's group file). Statements under statements (outside bands) are shown to every band.
title: Sample statements by level

lower.text: I can give a reason for my answer.
I can try another way when my first way does not work.

upper.text: I can weigh evidence on more than one side before I decide.
I can carry a method into an unfamiliar problem and adjust it.

statements.text: I can ask my own questions and test my ideas.
I can explain an idea clearly and check that my listener followed.
I can connect what I learn to life in Singapore.
I can name what I feel and what I can do about it.
